crew.overview: Now a detective-for-hire like her infamous brother, Enola Holmes takes on her first official case to find a missing girl, as the sparks of a dangerous conspiracy ignite a mystery that requires the help of friends — and Sherlock himself — to unravel.
crew.title: Enola Holmes 2

details.biography:
Paul Sultana is known for The Flash (2023), Enola Holmes 2 (2022) and Blue Snakes. Paul trained at the Florida School for the Perfoming Arts.

He was the recipient of a 2020 July Award Independent Shorts Awards for Best Acting Ensemble for the movie Lavender
details.name: Paul Sultana
